advancement.bakingdelight.acdcc.desc: Craft an AC/DC Converter to convert between the two power types, with some energy lost in the process.
advancement.bakingdelight.acdcc.title: AC & DC
advancement.bakingdelight.bamboo_steamer: Get ready to build a traditional steamer with a bamboo steamer basket drawer, bamboo steamer cover, and cauldron!
advancement.bakingdelight.battery1.desc: Make a simple battery, which is the beginning of all power storage.
advancement.bakingdelight.battery1.title: Introduction to Electricity Storage
advancement.bakingdelight.battery2.desc: Make an intermediate battery and you'll be able to store more power again!
advancement.bakingdelight.battery2.title: Advanced Power Storage
advancement.bakingdelight.battery3.desc: Craft an Advanced Battery to store a whole lot more power!
advancement.bakingdelight.battery3.title: I need more electricity!
advancement.bakingdelight.battery4.desc: Craft a Dimensional Battery and put your power storage worries in another dimension.
advancement.bakingdelight.battery4.title: Is There No End to This Power?
advancement.bakingdelight.bdc_bdi.desc: Craft a biogas digester controller and a biogas digester I/O port. Remember to read their instructions and build your biogas digester!
advancement.bakingdelight.bdc_bdi.title: Biogas Industry
Craft a Charging Post to recharge DC-powered appliances!
advancement.bakingdelight.click_gas_cook: Rapidly right-click a Gas Cooking Stove 10 times within 3 seconds. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.bakingdelight.cooked_portabl: Add packaged instant noodles, quicklime, and water to a Portable Pot, then cook up a quick meal.
Craft a Cuisine Table. Place a tool in the top slot and an item below to break many ingredients down.
advancement.bakingdelight.deep_fry_baske: Use tongs to retrieve food from the Deep Fryer. Hot oil is no joke!
advancement.bakingdelight.deep_fryer.des: Right-click to add oil or insert and remove items. Sneak and right-click to check its status. It needs oil and a connected Gas Canister to run.
advancement.bakingdelight.electric_steam: An electric steamer allows you to get rid of the complexity of building a traditional steamer.
advancement.bakingdelight.electric_whisk: Regular whisk with glass bowl is too slow to mix manually? Try an electric whisk! It works directly on drops!
advancement.bakingdelight.electricians_d: Make an electrician's desk, and it'll be with you for a long time to come.
advancement.bakingdelight.filter.desc: Put a filter and a cooked oil crop, such as sunflower seeds, in the Wooden Basin, then stomp on it to press out the oil.
advancement.bakingdelight.filter.title: Beginning of a life of labor
advancement.bakingdelight.fish_and_chips: Make a portion of fish and chips, excellent!
Deep-fry some noodles, then combine them with a honeycomb-and-paper wrapper to make instant noodles.
advancement.bakingdelight.garlic.desc: Find garlic in villagers' houses or in the forest.
advancement.bakingdelight.garlic.title: Garlic: Vampires Hate This One Trick
advancement.bakingdelight.gas_canister.d: It can either load gas from the biogas digester I/O port or supply gas to a gas cooking stove. Remember to be safe though!
advancement.bakingdelight.gas_cooking_st: A Gas Cooking Stove can heat all sorts of things, including you. Keep your distance!
advancement.bakingdelight.get_advance_fu: Craft an Advanced Furnace: it smelts items four times faster than a regular furnace!
advancement.bakingdelight.get_baking_tra: Place it inside an Advanced Furnace to upgrade it into an Oven.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_black_pepp: Discover this new crop in a village home or the jungle.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_butter_des: Whisk cream in a Glass Bowl to churn it into butter.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_cheese.des: Cook milk in the oven to make cheese.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_cream_buck: Whisk a milk bucket in a Glass Bowl to obtain a cream bucket.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_crowbar.de: Right-click to downgrade an Oven or quickly break doors and windows. Whatever you do, don't hit anyone with it.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_crowbar.ti: Physics Is More of a Suggestion
advancement.bakingdelight.get_egg_tart_d: Add cream, mixed dough, egg, then sugar to the oven to bake an egg tart.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_freezer_de: It's time to let the ingredients cool down a bit, and this freezer can cold process quite a few things!
advancement.bakingdelight.get_glass_bowl: Be careful not to break the bowl.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_kneading_s: It's just an ordinary wooden stick.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_mashed_pot: Place a potato in a Glass Bowl and whisk it to make mashed potatoes.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_oven_desc: The oven will help you bake better food.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_pizza.desc: Bake in this order: ground black pepper, sugar, ground black pepper, then raw pizza.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_potato_sta: Whisk mashed potatoes in a Glass Bowl to make potato starch.
Start with flattened dough and cheese, add five ingredients of your choice, then finish with another cheese.
Getting ready to open a pizzeria!
advancement.bakingdelight.get_start_desc: A simple mod guide begins here. Let's get cooking!
advancement.bakingdelight.get_wheat_doug: Pour water into a Glass Bowl, add wheat flour, and knead it into dough! Roll it flat with a Kneading Stick, or bake some bread.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_wheat_flou: Whisk wheat in a Glass Bowl to make wheat flour.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_whisk_desc: Craft a whisk to start your new kitchen journey.
advancement.bakingdelight.get_whisk_titl: The truth is it's a whisk
advancement.bakingdelight.ice_cream.desc: Watch an ice cream cone come together!
advancement.bakingdelight.ice_cream_make: Make an ice cream maker. When you take out the ice cream, you can definitely double your excitement!
advancement.bakingdelight.juice_extracto: Make a juice extractor and make some drinks with it!
advancement.bakingdelight.kebabs.desc: Grill a squid tentacle kebab. It's delicious and healthy.
advancement.bakingdelight.kebabs.title: Have a Kebab
advancement.bakingdelight.kuh.title: Beautify the kitchen
advancement.bakingdelight.matcha.title: Sweet Smell
advancement.bakingdelight.pg.desc: Make a photovoltaic generator that's portable and eco-friendly
advancement.bakingdelight.pg.title: Environmentally Friendly
Smelt quartz in a blast furnace to obtain silicon ingots.
advancement.bakingdelight.spatula.desc: Heat up a baking tray on the burning gas cooking stove, then add ingredients to it and stir-fry with a spatula.
advancement.bakingdelight.spatula.title: It's stir-fry time!
advancement.bakingdelight.steamed_bun.de: Steam some dough to make a steamed bun.
advancement.bakingdelight.stone_mortar.d: Make a stone mortar which will help you crush some things.
advancement.bakingdelight.tesla_coil.des: Craft a Tesla Coil and send power through the air. Who needs wires?
advancement.bakingdelight.thermal_power_: Craft a Stirling Engine and Faraday Generator. Mount the engine on a working furnace and connect its flywheel to the generator to produce power!
Congratulations, you're not far from deep-frying food.
advancement.bakingdelight.wind.desc: Make a fan blade and a wind turbine controller and start feeling the power from nature!
advancement.bakingdelight.wind.title: The Wind is Passing by
advancement.bakingdelight.wither_rose_ca: Eat the wither rose cake, then think about your life. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.bakingdelight.wooden_basin.d: Apparently it's a tool for extracting oil.

bakingdelight.tooltips.acdcc: A bidirectional AC/DC converter. In AC->DC mode it converts and stores power from an AC generator, and can charge batteries. In DC->AC mode it outputs stored or battery power as AC. Adjust its efficiency in the GUI; FE, RF and AE conversion is also supported.
bakingdelight.tooltips.baking_tray: A small, easy-to-use iron plate for upgrading an Advanced Furnace or stir-frying. Heat it with a Gas Cooking Stove, place food on top, then stir-fry it five times with a spatula.
bakingdelight.tooltips.bamboo_steamer: A simple bamboo steamer, requires a cover, basket drawers, and a gas cooking stove heated cauldron filled with water, add the ingredients and it will start the process, a Steamer can be stacked 3 blocks high, each block can hold 4 layers.
bakingdelight.tooltips.bdc: The core of a biogas digester. When a flat, completely sealed cuboid space exists beneath it, the controller recognizes it automatically.
bakingdelight.tooltips.bdi: Activates when placed above a working biogas digester controller. Fill it with food to ferment it into biogas. Attach a gas canister to the side to fill it with biogas.
bakingdelight.tooltips.butter: That sticky texture... maybe it's good for something besides food.
bakingdelight.tooltips.charging_post: A device for charging DC appliances. Right-click to open the GUI. Place at least one battery in either of the two slots on the left, and the appliance to charge in the slot on the right.
bakingdelight.tooltips.condiment_tip: Seasoning item, hold this in one hand and any food in the other hand to season the food.
bakingdelight.tooltips.cuisine_table: The cuisine table allows you to deepen the ingredients and use it with a tool that breaks down the ingredients into more parts.
bakingdelight.tooltips.cuttlebone: Dropped when a squid is killed with an amethyst tool.
bakingdelight.tooltips.deep_fryer: A deep fryer for cooking a variety of foods. Add cooking oil, place a Gas Canister behind it, press the front button, then add food to start frying. Hold Shift and right-click to view its status.
bakingdelight.tooltips.electric_steamer: Like a regular steamer, but it consumes AC power to heat the water and can only process 12 ingredients at once, it has the advantage of taking up little space and does not require additional heating equipment.
bakingdelight.tooltips.electric_whisk: Like a regular whisk, it can be used with a glass bowl to enable whisking of food, but it will consume DC power and you will need a charging post to charge it. In addition, it is also effective to the drops on the ground.
bakingdelight.tooltips.electricians_desk: The electrician's desk allows you to synthesize and process some complex circuit components or appliances, after placing the material correctly into the desk, click on the output button that appears in the GUI to start the synthesis. There are 3 different types of mini-games: 1. 2048 (by pressing WASD to synthesize the specified number); 2. Splicing of the circuit board (reproduce the pattern of the "?" screen, the screwdriver can remove the pattern); 3. Hanno's Tower (just move the left tower to the right, narrow blocks can only be placed on wide blocks); Finish the mini-game and then press that output button again to get the finished product.
bakingdelight.tooltips.failed_seasoning: You can't add more seasoning to this food.
bakingdelight.tooltips.fan_blade: A fan blade for wind power generation, which can be mounted on the wind turbine controller or placed elsewhere for decorative purposes, its rotation speed depends on the current altitude and weather conditions.
bakingdelight.tooltips.faraday_generator: When properly mounted behind the flywheel of a Stirling engine, AC power is generated, be sure that the flywheel of the Stirling engine and the generator must look like they are just able to be connected in order to generate power.
bakingdelight.tooltips.filter: A string filter for the wooden basin. It filters oil and sludge.
bakingdelight.tooltips.freezer: A simple freezer, which can be used for storing items or cold processing some ingredients, can be cooled by consuming some refrigerants, such as ice, or by directly consuming AC electricity.
bakingdelight.tooltips.gas_cooking_stove: When it is flanked by a gas canister containing gas, right-click to activate it, and when activated, it can heat up the block above it, including baking tray, oven, and Advanced Furnaces, all of which are compatible.
bakingdelight.tooltips.glass_bowl: A container for processing and whisking ingredients that needs to be used with a whisk, water can also be poured into it for "mixing with water".
bakingdelight.tooltips.holder: Safely remove items from the Deep Fryer and transfer items between containers. Right-click to release a held item; right-click while empty-handed to grab the item in your other hand.
bakingdelight.tooltips.ice_cream_maker: Hold Shift and right-click to open the GUI. Add cream of any flavor, sugar, and eggs, then supply AC power. Select the flavors to mix, then hold an ice cream cone and right-click to serve.
bakingdelight.tooltips.industrial_fermen: Harness the power of microbes to transform simple ingredients into fine wine, vinegar, and more.
bakingdelight.tooltips.juice_extractor: A juice extractor that runs on AC power. Right-click while holding an ingredient to insert it; once both ingredients are loaded, right-click again to start the machine.
bakingdelight.tooltips.need_food: You need to hold any food in your other hand.
bakingdelight.tooltips.p_gen: A photovoltaic generator converts light energy into DC electrical energy and stores it, batteries can be plugged in and charged, and the amount of power generated depends on factors such as current altitude, time of day, weather, block light and sky light.
bakingdelight.tooltips.spatula: It can be used with a heated tray to stir-fry foods.
bakingdelight.tooltips.sterling_engine: Mount the Stirling Engine on a lit furnace, blast furnace, smoker, Advanced Furnace or Oven, then connect it to a Faraday Generator to produce AC power. A sponge dampens its noise.
bakingdelight.tooltips.tesla_coil: The Tesla Coil can transmit AC power remotely, and when placed on a device that generates AC power it spreads the power over an area of 8 blocks east, south, west, north, up, and down. Enable the visualization in the GUI to see the 48-block area. AC appliances and other Tesla Coils in range receive power, while nearby mobs can be shocked and damaged.
bakingdelight.tooltips.trawler: A device used for harvesting aquatic products; it can only be placed on the water's surface. Right-click to raise or lower the trawl net. When the trawl net is on the water's surface, press Shift and right-click to open the GUI. Bait is optional.
bakingdelight.tooltips.turnip: A slight grudge from the author.
bakingdelight.tooltips.whisk: A whisk that can be used to mix ingredients, or... whisk the brains of monsters?
bakingdelight.tooltips.wooden_basin: Extract vegetable oil by adding an oil crop (such as stir-fried sunflower seeds) and a filter, then stand on the basin and jump. Collect the oil with a glass bottle or bucket.
bakingdelight.tooltips.wooden_plate: A plate for displaying items. Right-click to place an item on it; sneak and right-click to rotate it.
bakingdelight.tooltips.wtc: When the fan blades are properly installed, the controller will begin to operate and generate AC power, the amount of power generated depends on the current altitude and weather conditions.
